title: Son of Sara
review: Rosemary's Baby but with queer themes. It also reminded me of Shelby Oaks. I thought the actress who played Sara did a good job of selling the gross/scary scenes. The main villain, Troy, was also very slimy and added to my enjoyment of the film. My only criticism is how it doesn't explain very well why Sara was so easily convinced to go to a random farm with her ex. The story is predictable but the ending goes a different direction than expected with similar films.
